content:
Excited to share that I’ve joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**!

I’ve been working with the CDS Hooks standard since **2017**, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to help guide and support the community as we continue to move the standard forward. I’m especially looking forward to collaborating with implementers and stakeholders to keep CDS Hooks practical, interoperable, and impactful in real-world clinical workflows.

A quick request for the community:
- **If you’re already using CDS Hooks**, please add your implementation to the availability list: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability  
- **If you’re not using CDS Hooks yet** and are considering it, I’m available as a **freelance consultant** to help with strategy, implementation, and integration.

Looking forward to what’s ahead.
